title: Montserrat day tour
text: In my second visit to Barcelona I could not miss an excursion to Montserrat. I am a lover of hiking and nature, but also of culture, and in Montserrat you can do everything and more! We went through the wine production area, we even made a stop for a wine. A special mention to our guide, Adolfo, a great professional.
author: 46conorg

title: Monteserrat
text:
One of the most spectacular landscapes I saw in Spain! 
The enclave of the monastery, in the middle of the rock, is something supernatural.
Our guide, Marc, was the perfect host, we loved spending the day with him.
author: nuria_caro

title: Montserrat trip
text:
This excursion to Montserrat has been one of the highlights of my trip to Spain! Whether you have religious motives or not, the scenery is so spectacular that you must go.

And if you are lucky enough to go with Marc as your guide, success is guaranteed!
author: JenCarPer

title: Excellent trip!
text: I recommend this excursion to the montserrat area, if you are a wine lover choose the option to visit the wine production area. We also liked the monastery, especially the natural and rocky environment. Our guide was fantastic.
author: antonioaL1991

title: amazing trip
text: Incredible daytrip to Montserrat from Barcelona. The driving was easy, the deal with the company very efficient and our guide a great lover of Montserrat and Spain. Without a doubt, to repeat.
author: C280FIeduardos
